name: Daniel Agasi
title: Performance Marketing & Digital Growth
tagline: I help brands grow through data-driven marketing, technical SEO, and smart technology.
bio: Specializing in performance marketing, SEO, web development, and marketing technology. I bridge the gap between creative strategy and technical execution — turning data into growth.

experience.description: Led paid media strategy across Meta, Google, and TikTok. Managed Rp 500M+ monthly budget.
Drove organic growth for 10+ clients across e-commerce and SaaS verticals.
Full-stack digital marketing covering paid ads, SEO, email, and analytics.

services.title: Performance Marketing
services.description: Full-funnel paid media strategy and execution across Meta, Google, TikTok, and programmatic platforms. From campaign setup to ROAS optimization.

services.title: SEO
services.description: Technical and strategic SEO that drives sustainable organic growth. From audit to execution — I fix what holds your site back and build what pushes it forward.

services.title: Web Development
services.description: Fast, conversion-optimized websites and landing pages built for performance. Every page is built to load fast, rank well, and convert visitors.

services.title: Marketing Technology
services.description: Build and integrate your martech stack so your data is clean, your tracking is accurate, and your reporting tells the full story.

faqs.question: What industries do you specialize in?
faqs.answer: I have deep experience in e-commerce, fintech, and consumer brands — but my methodology applies to any business that runs paid media or relies on organic growth.

faqs.question: Do you work with international clients?
faqs.answer: Yes. I work remotely with clients across Southeast Asia and beyond. Most collaboration happens async via Slack or Notion, with regular video calls.

faqs.question: How do you measure success?
faqs.answer: Every engagement starts with agreeing on KPIs. For paid media, that's ROAS and CAC. For SEO, it's organic traffic and keyword rankings. For MarTech, it's data accuracy and reporting efficiency.

faqs.question: Do you take on freelance projects?
faqs.answer: Yes, I take on select freelance and consulting projects. The best way to start is to send me a brief through the contact page and we'll take it from there.
